GeneDef.label: corrupted soul
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have a soul twisted by something older than humanity. Taken from them, it becomes corrupted essence rather than clean. Their blows can carry a curse.

XenotypeDef.label: demon
XenotypeDef.description: Horned, red-skinned and hard to kill, demons come up out of the hell gates with corrupted souls and a hunger for everyone else's. Nobody agrees on whether they were ever human. They are hyper-aggressive, shrug off fire and punishment, and hit hard up close. Their blows can leave a curse behind.\n\nTake a demon's soul and you get corrupted essence: stronger than clean, and dangerous to handle.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Horned, red, robust and fire-resistant, demons are hyper-aggressive brawlers whose blows can curse. Their souls are corrupted.
